title: Migrate Workspaces Launcher UI from WPF to WinUI 3
author: chatasweetie
summary: The durable fork review was resumed and completed through three repair rounds. The candidate was rebased onto live upstream main 65d79b27b93b7883c6010e5e57b638c6de9725f4, moved to fork PR 760 after protected-branch rules prevented updating the prior fork PR, and advanced to head e5496b76f96bb4655e2a142c405487296eccc54a. The latest two published Copilot findings and one companion suppressed spelling-order finding were fixed, replied to, and resolved. Required x64 Debug builds succeeded and the expanded launcher test suite passed 135/135. Fork PR 760 already has Copilot requested for the exact current head, so no duplicate request was made and this run checkpoints waiting_copilot.
